nomination.name: StarFoot 1.0.19: Manager mode, school years, friends
nomination.description: StarFoot is a football (soccer) career game by a solo indie developer from Türkiye: start in a street match, get spotted by scouts and rise to the world's biggest clubs, playing the key moments of every match yourself. Version 1.0.19 is our biggest update yet. A new Manager mode puts players in charge of a club: build the squad, pick tactics, run matches live from the touchline with substitutions and half-time talks, negotiate transfers and face the press. The player career goes deeper: school years with exams and report cards, friends who grow up to become players, journalists or agents, a driving test, open university, language courses and holidays. Players can request a transfer to any club, earn signing bonuses and a share of shirt sales, go out on loan and develop a personality that changes with how they play. 40+ new national teams and StarFoot Diamond, an all-in-one purchase, complete the update. Fully localized in 10 languages; all names are fictional.
nomination.notes: Solo indie developer from Türkiye. Happy to provide additional assets or a TestFlight build.
